note: The Outland Gate kit's adapter onto the material library (core/materials/PLAN.md; biomes/outlandgate/PLAN.md section 8). Station 1, the Narrows: three ground layers (src/84-host-ground.js, KGROUND): ground.grass.lush (the Cfa floor's meadow), ground.shingle (the braid bars), ground.brown_mud_02 (the channels' lips). The trees are ebadlands' (read in place: their families come from its pack, build.py's KIN). Run python3 tools/textures/pack.py biomes/outlandgate after any change, then build. Stations 2-4 (2026-11-11) add ground.travertine (the West Bench's seeps), ground.moss (its alcoves) and ground.reedbed (the Spider Lake Threshold's sedge flats); each page packs only its own three (build.py FAM1, station.json "families").
